# Lyrenza Paris Left Bank

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Paris Left Bank is in Paris, France, in the Europe region.
Facilities: Courtyard restaurant; compact spa; family suites; no pool. Pool or water-facility hours: No pool.
Parking: Valet parking; EUR 48 nightly. Transportation: Metro station is a four-minute walk.
